decisions.reason: Extracts text from each real PDF page and supports page-local Unicode code-point offsets.
decisions.limitation: This M0 probe covers text PDFs only; scanned PDFs and OCR remain out of scope.

decisions.entrypoint: bounded ZIP entry inflate + Cheerio XML mode
decisions.reason: Reading w:p nodes directly preserves empty paragraphs and duplicate paragraph identity for the zero-based docx_paragraph locator.
decisions.limitation: M0 reads text and paragraph styles from the main document part; aggregate expansion checks include ZIP declarations while actual output is bounded for document.xml, and unreferenced ZIP parts are not inflated or CRC-validated. This is not a complete ZIP bomb audit. Pagination, run styling, OCR, and full layout fidelity are also out of scope.

decisions.reason: Tolerant HTML parsing preserves heading paths and existing fragment IDs without fabricating anchors.
decisions.limitation: The probe accepts captured HTML bytes; network fetching and URL safety are separate work.

textFormats.reason: TXT/MD use Node UTF-8 decoding and line parsing, avoiding unnecessary dependencies.
textFormats.limitation: Markdown extraction here preserves headings and line ranges, not every dialect extension.

rejectedAlternative.reason: Semantic HTML output may omit empty paragraphs, so its output index cannot prove the original DOCX paragraphIndex.
rejectedAlternative.securityObservation: Mammoth was not selected and is absent from the final parser dependency set. During selection, npm audit identified its transitive argparse -> sprintf-js <=1.1.3 finding; this probe does not import or execute Mammoth CLI code.

acceptanceBoundary: This report covers M0 parser evidence only; it does not claim full AC-07 or AC-22 product acceptance.
